description: Exact discharging and structural analysis of Swarm floor rows Row A (7/7665566/6765776), Row B (7/7666666/6567656), H05 (7/7676655/7657666), the mrowL [6,6,*] two-row cycle on a 7-7 edge, and the d7 link-8578656 class

mrowL_66_two_row_cycle.explanation: At the 7-7 dart i=0, both Row A (7/7665566/6765776) and Row B (7/7666666/6567656) have w_{-2}=w_{-1}=s_{-1}=6 and w_{+2}=w_{+1}=s_0=6, so tau_x(7,7,side_x(6,6,6),side_x(6,6,6)) cancels identically (+1 - 1 = 0) on both rows. Before f2b_extra(d7_w7), Row A has -2*lq(6,6,5) + 2*lQ(6,6,30) (raw MASK=30) and Row B has -2*lq(6,6,6) + 2*lQ(6,6,31) (raw MASK=31). Because bit 6 is in mask 30 ({6,7,8,9}) and bit 5 is in raw mask 31 ({5,6,7,8,9}), the two mrowL inequalities lq(6,6,6) - lQ(6,6,30) <= 0 and lq(6,6,5) - lQ(6,6,31) <= 0 form a 2-cycle that cancels all lq/lQ variables in the combination (Row_A + Row_B + 2*mrowL((6,6,30),(6,6,6)) + 2*mrowL((6,6,31),(6,6,5))). Crucially, with f2b_extra(d7_w7) active, f2b rule d7_w7 kills bit 5 on Row B (f2b_extra=1), tightening Row B's lQ from (6,6,31) to (6,6,30) and forbidding mrowL((6,6,30),(6,6,5)), while leaving Row B + 2*mrowL((6,6,30),(6,6,6)) as a self-loop on (6,6,6) that Row A feeds into via lQ(6,6,30). Geometrically, around the shared degree-6 neighbor c = w_{+1}(u) = w_{-1}(v) = 6 on a 7-7 edge u-v, the 6 neighbors of c are (u, w_{+2}(u), s_1(u), s_{-2}(v), w_{-2}(v), v), which forces priv(w_{+1}(u)) = s_{-2}(v) = S.A-1(v) and priv(w_{-1}(u)) = s_1(v) = S.A+1(v) (as encoded in phase0_check.py lines 570-571). Because lq(6,6,*) forgets S.A+1 and S.A-1 (which are 7,7 on Row A vs 5,5 on Row B), EDGE rules that condition on S.A+1/S.A-1 or S.L+3/S.L-3 cleanly separate Row A and Row B.
